title: Depth-independent Fold mass-ratio family
statement: At every positive combined-ladder depth d, complete binary-by-generator support forces light part 1/N, heavy complement (N-1)/N and heavy-to-light ratio N-1 for N=2 times 3^d.
generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis product for depth-independent fold mass-ratio family from carrier, dependency, relation, enumeration, minimality, measurement direction, record and extension.
grammar_boundary: Every exact finite carrier named by the law and the complete product of its eight registered binary form axes.

exact_result: For every positive d, heavy/light = 2*3^d-1; the first three values are 5, 17 and 53.
induction_base: Depth one has complete support six and ratio five.
induction_step: Each depth successor triples the generator support while preserving the light/complement partition and the N-1 identity.
